witness.branch: Other traffic during entry and stopped loading
witness.quote: so as not to unduly impede the movement of other vehicular traffic.
witness.reason: Another vehicle on a one-way road permits observation of traffic movement around a loading bus after a qualifying entry.
required_context: Construct passenger or baggage loading purpose and activity, entry route and stopped interval.
Covered non-tour bus and identified operator.
Establish bus classification, exclusion facts, operator identity, public-street status and jurisdiction.
Other vehicle's route, motion and timing; presence alone does not establish passing or interference.
Passenger or baggage purpose and actual loading position.
Preserve approximately parallel and unduly impede without numerical cutoffs, and retain unresolved NRS incorporation and location terminology.
Qualifying loading location, curb and applicable designation on a public street.
Specify actual right-front-wheel geometry, curb surface and measurement precision; body extent alone is insufficient.
Specify the other vehicle's route, timing and motion; retain wheel distance, orientation, passage space, speeds and delays as observations.
Supply a qualifying location, boundaries, applicable designation and signs.
witness.subject_reason: bus_driver is available and can operate the covered bus; the other_vehicle control supplies a separate participant.
